### CVE-2026-21569
- Assigner: atlassian | Published: 2026-01-28 | Updated: 2026-01-28 | Max CVSS: 7.9
- CWE: XXE (XML External Entity Injection); CWE-611 CWE-611 Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.9 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

This High severity XXE (XML External Entity Injection) vulnerability was introduced in version 7.1.0 of Crowd Data Center and Server. 
	
	This XXE (XML External Entity Injection) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 7.9, allows an authenticated attacker to access local and remote content which has high impact to confidentiality, low impact to integrity, high impact to availability, and requires no user interaction. 
	
	Atlassian recommends that Crowd Data Center and Server customers upgrade to latest version, if you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions:
		
		* Crowd Data Center and Server 7.1: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 7.1.3
		
		
	
	See the release notes (https://confluence.atlassian.com/crowd/crowd-release-notes-199094.html). You can download the latest version of Crowd Data Center and Server from the download center (https://www.atlassian.com/software/crowd/download-archive). 
	
	This vulnerability was reported via our Atlassian (Internal) program.

Affected:
- Atlassian / Crowd Data Center: affected 7.1.0 to 7.1.2; unaffected 7.1.3

References:
- https://confluence.atlassian.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1712324819

### CVE-2026-21589
- Assigner: atlassian | Published: 2026-10-05 | Updated: 2026-10-29 | Max CVSS: 9.3
- CWE: Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write); CWE-552 CWE-552 Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 9.3 CRITICAL `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2026-10-15, ransomware=Unknown — Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability

This is a vulnerability in Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center. Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye. This Arbitrary File Access vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path; this vulnerability does not allow attackers to enumerate or list directory contents. In some configurations, there may be some sensitive files that make this highly severe. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. The vulnerability must be addressed for affected versions of: -- Bitbucket Data Center, introduced in version >= 4.6.0, fix versions: 9.4.26, 10.2.8, 10.5.1 -- Confluence Data Center, introduced in version >= 5.10.0, fix versions 9.2.26, 10.2.19 -- Crowd Data Center, introduced in version >= 2.11.0, fix versions 6.3.7, 7.0.3, 7.1.7, 7.2.4 -- Jira Software Data Center, introduced in version >= 7.1.0, fix versions 9.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Jira Service Management Data Center, introduced in version >= 3.1.0, fix versions 5.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Bamboo Data Center >= 7.0.1, fix versions 10.2.24, 12.1.12 -- Crucible, fix versions 4.9.15 -- Fisheye, fix version 4.9.15 -- Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path. The vulnerability does not include the capability to enumerate or list directory contents.

Affected:
- Atlassian / Bamboo Data Center: affected All other versions; unaffected Patch version 10.2.24 and later; unaffected Patch version 12.1.12 and later
- Atlassian / Bitbucket Data Center: affected All other versions; unaffected Patch version 10.2.8 and later; unaffected Patch version 10.5.1 and later; unaffected Patch version 9.4.26 and later

### CVE-2026-21592
- Assigner: atlassian | Published: 2026-11-17 | Updated: 2026-11-17 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write); CWE-22 CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

This High severity Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability known as CVE-2026-21592 was introduced in version 4.9.0.

This Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 7.7 and a CVSS Vector of CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose protected application configuration files, which has high impact to confidentiality, no impact to integrity, no impact to availability, and requires no user interaction.

Atlassian recommends that Crucible Server customers upgrade to the latest version. If you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to the specified supported fixed version:
 Crucible Server 4.9: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 4.9.16

See the Crucible Server release notes ([https://confluence.atlassian.com/crucible/crucible-releases-298977378.html]). You can download the latest version of Crucible from the Crucible Download Archives ([https://www.atlassian.com/software/crucible/download-archives]).

The following description summarizes the vulnerability reported via our Penetration Testing program:

Crucible do not account for path parameters when validating protected paths requested through the static-resource route. A crafted path segment passes validation, after which Jetty removes the path parameter during dispatch and resolves the request to a protected resource. This can expose files under WEB-INF and permit direct invocation of admin-area JSPs outside the normal interceptor and administrative password checks. An ordinary authenticated user can exploit the issue, and unauthenticated exploitation is possible when anonymous access is enabled.

Affected:
- Atlassian / Crucible Data Center: affected 4.9.0 to 4.9.15; unaffected 4.9.16
- Atlassian / Fisheye Data Center: affected 4.9.0 to 4.9.15; unaffected 4.9.16

This High severity Stored XSS vulnerability was introduced in version 10.3.26 of Jira Core Data Center and Jira Software Data Center. 
	
	This Stored XSS vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 7.4, allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript code on a victims browser. 
	
	Atlassian recommends that Jira Core Data Center and Jira Software Data Center customers upgrade to latest version, if you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions:
		
		* Jira Core Data Center and Jira Software Data Center 10.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.3.27
		
		* Jira Core Data Center and Jira Software Data Center 11.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.3.13
		
		
	
	See the release notes (https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/download-archives). You can download the latest version of Jira Core Data Center and Jira Software Data Center from the download center (https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/download-archives). 
	
	This vulnerability was reported via our Penetration Testing program.

Affected:
- Atlassian / Jira Core Data Center: affected 10.3.26; unaffected 11.3.13; unaffected 10.3.27
- Atlassian / Jira Software Data Center: affected 10.3.26; unaffected 11.3.13; unaffected 10.3.27

- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

This High severity Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability known as CVE-2026-21605 was introduced in versions 2.0.0, 3.0.0, 4.0.0, 5.0.0, 6.0.1, 6.1.0, 6.2.0, 6.3.1, 6.4.0, 6.5.0, 6.6.0 ,6.7.0, 6.8.0, 6.9.0, 6.10.0, 6.11.0, 6.12.0, 6.13.0, 6.14.0, 6.15.1, 7.0.1, 7.1.0, 7.2.0, 7.3.1, 7.4.0, 7.5.0, 7.6.0, 7.7.2, 7.8.0, 7.9.0, 7.11.0, 7.12.0, 7.13.0, 7.14.0, 7.15.0, 7.16.0, 7.17.0, 7.18.0, 7.19.0, 7.20.0, 8.0.0, 8.1.0, 8.2.0, 8.3.0, 8.4.0, 8.5.0, 8.6.0, 8.7.1, 8.8.0, 8.9.0, 9.0.1, 9.1.0, 9.2.0, 9.3.1, 9.4.0, 9.5.1, 10.0.2, 10.1.0, 10.2.0, and 11.0.0 of Confluence Data Center.

This Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 8.7 and a CVSS Vector of CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N allows an unauthenticated attacker to expose assets in your environment susceptible to exploitation, which has high impact to confidentiality, no impact to integrity, no impact to availability, and requires no user interaction.

Atlassian recommends that Confluence Data Center and Server customers upgrade to the latest version. If you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions:
 Confluence Data Center 11.0: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.0.1
 Confluence Data Center 10.2: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.2.20
 Confluence Data Center 9.2: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 9.2.27

See the release notes ([https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/confluence-release-notes-327.html]). You can download the
latest version of Confluence Data Center and Server from the download center
([https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/download-archives]).

The following description summarizes the vulnerability reported internally:

Confluence CssServlet forwards a request-controlled path to ServletRequest.getRequestDispatcher. The dispatcher URL-decodes and normalizes the path, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to use an encoded traversal sequence to access protected web application resources such as /WEB-INF/web.xml. The demonstrated impact is disclosure of protected files that may contain configuration or secrets; no integrity or availability impact was demonstrated.

Affected:
- Atlassian / Confluence Data Center: affected 11.0.0; affected 10.2.0 to 10.2.19; affected 10.1.0 to 10.1.2; affected 10.0.2 to 10.0.3; affected 9.5.1 to 9.5.4; affected 9.4.0 to 9.4.1; affected 9.3.1 to 9.3.2; affected 9.2.0 to 9.2.26; affected 8.5.18 to 8.5.31; affected 7.19.30; unaffected 11.0.1; unaffected 10.2.20; unaffected 9.2.27 to 9.2.28
